Sometimes it’s all I can say.  I just have to accept this moment, this situation, I can’t rush through it so I just have to exist through it. What an honor and a struggle it is to exist through it. And what else is there I can do? So I say “ok” and accept it. Accept the circumstance, or the calling, or the end, the uncertainty, hardship, frustration of it all.  Things outside my control, but that obviously affect me, so what more is there to do or say than grin and bear it?  There’s a reason I have to embrace it this way, a purpose for why I’m forced into this position. Somehow life finds a Wah to turn me into a carnival contortionist and twists my soul to fit this path I’m on.  Just trying to take it in, to take it on, to get through it.  Sending love to everyone who feels similar right now, sometimes we just need people to believe in us. I believe in you. You’ve got this.  #1924us #life #animation #mrskelly #fyp

Meme history - Okay Movement are a series of Vine remix videos featuring a clip of a grinning man timidly saying "okay," which is often used as a comedic device in conjunction with various footage from TV shows, music videos and films. Origin - On December 29th, 2014, Viner Lilianna Hogan posted a Vine clip taken during her vacation at the Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda, which begins with a panoramic view of the vista before panning over to her Rwandan tour guide who replies "okay" with a smile after she says "hi" in greeting. In the first three months, the video received over 25 million loops, 520,000 likes and 294,000 revines. #meme #originalmeme #funny  #okay #ok
